description.value: A private campground and RV park on the Tsolum River, half a kilometre from the highway and minutes from Courtenay's shops and services, with hot showers, laundry, and a dedicated cyclist/backpacker rate; primarily an RV operation but a practical city-edge stop for touring riders.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and serves as the primary evidence source. The site confirms the address, main phone number, and amenities including hot showers, coin-operated laundry, water hookups, and Wi-Fi. The rates page explicitly lists a 'Special rate for backpackers / cyclists (no vehicle)' as a distinct lower-priced category, confirming both hiker/biker-friendly sites and a cyclist discount. The OSM name 'Maple Pool Campsite' differs from the website's consistent branding as 'Maple Pool Campground & RV Park', which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Maple Pool Campsite' but the website consistently uses 'Maple Pool Campground & RV Park'.

Two different phone numbers appear on the website: 250-338-9386 (main contact shown in footer and find-us page) and +1 (250) 792-0738 (listed on the reservations subpage for bookings). OSM lists only the main number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground with an explicit cyclist/backpacker rate category, hot showers, laundry, and water access — a clear fit for the WWC cycling tourism directory.

wow_evidence: Special rate for backpackers / cyclists (no vehicle)… hot showers, coin-operated laundry
